answer: Proposal: invite budgets. Each epoch the chain grants one ticket per member key; a candidate joins only with k tickets from distinct keys, each endorser's bond slashed if the entrant is proven a duplicate. Extra candidates are worthless without tickets, so membership grows at most M/k per epoch — glacier pace, no velvet rope of unlimited invites. An outsider is an island: entry takes k member keys, owned or bought. A clique of m keys compounds ×(1+1/k) per epoch; paraphrased clones dodge the slash, so the cap, not the price, is the guarantee. Tickets bind keys, not persons.
